title: peucedanum euryptera
intro: Peucedanum euryptera, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum euryptera include acting as a diuretic, stimulating digestion, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
